entities.summary: Pavel Petrovich Anosov (10 July 1796, Tver — 25 May 1851 was a Russian mining engineer, a metallurgical scientist, a major organizer of the mining industry, a researcher of the nature of the Southern Ural, governor of Tomsk and a General-Major.
